From 52d2edea0d63c935e82631e4b9e4a94eccf97b5b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vinicius Costa Gomes <vinicius.gomes@intel.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 10:34:28 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] dmaengine: idxd: Fix crash when the event log is disabled

If reporting errors to the event log is not supported by the hardware,
and an error that causes Function Level Reset (FLR) is received, the
driver will try to restore the event log even if it was not allocated.

Also, only try to free the event log if it was properly allocated.

Fixes: 6078a315aec1 ("dmaengine: idxd: Add idxd_device_config_save() and idxd_device_config_restore() helpers")
Reviewed-by: Dave Jiang <dave.jiang@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinicius Costa Gomes <vinicius.gomes@intel.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260121-idxd-fix-flr-on-kernel-queues-v3-v3-2-7ed70658a9d1@intel.com
Signed-off-by: Vinod Koul <vkoul@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/dma/idxd/device.c b/drivers/dma/idxd/device.c
index a704475d87b3..5265925f3076 100644
--- a/drivers/dma/idxd/device.c
+++ b/drivers/dma/idxd/device.c
@@ -831,6 +831,9 @@ static void idxd_device_evl_free(struct idxd_device *idxd)
 	struct device *dev = &idxd->pdev->dev;
 	struct idxd_evl *evl = idxd->evl;
 
+	if (!evl)
+		return;
+
 	gencfg.bits = ioread32(idxd->reg_base + IDXD_GENCFG_OFFSET);
 	if (!gencfg.evl_en)
 		return;

diff --git a/drivers/dma/idxd/init.c b/drivers/dma/idxd/init.c
index dd32b81a3108..1c3f9bc7364b 100644
--- a/drivers/dma/idxd/init.c
+++ b/drivers/dma/idxd/init.c
@@ -973,7 +973,8 @@ static void idxd_device_config_restore(struct idxd_device *idxd,
 
 	idxd->rdbuf_limit = idxd_saved->saved_idxd.rdbuf_limit;
 
-	idxd->evl->size = saved_evl->size;
+	if (idxd->evl)
+		idxd->evl->size = saved_evl->size;
 
 	for (i = 0; i < idxd->max_groups; i++) {
 		struct idxd_group *saved_group, *group;
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a crash when the event log is disabled or not supported by hardware. Two modifications are made:

1. **`drivers/dma/idxd/device.c`** – In `idxd_device_evl_free()`, a null check for `idxd->evl` is added. If `evl` is NULL, the function returns early, preventing a crash when trying to free an unallocated event log.

2. **`drivers/dma/idxd/init.c`** – In `idxd_device_config_restore()`, a null check for `idxd->evl` is added before assigning `idxd->evl->size`. This prevents a null pointer dereference when the event log was not allocated (e.g., because it was disabled).

Both changes are related: they ensure that event log operations (freeing and restoring) are only performed when the event log has been properly allocated, avoiding crashes in scenarios where the hardware does not support event logging or it is disabled.

This patch fixes a crash that occurs when the hardware does not support event logging, and an error triggers a Function Level Reset (FLR). The modifications ensure that the driver only accesses or frees the event log (`evl`) if it has been properly allocated.

Specifically, two files are changed:

1. **`drivers/dma/idxd/init.c`** – In `idxd_device_config_restore()`, a null check (`if (idxd->evl)`) is added before assigning `saved_evl->size` to `idxd->evl->size`. This prevents a dereference of a null pointer when the event log was not allocated.

2. **`drivers/dma/idxd/device.c`** – In `idxd_device_evl_free()`, an early return is added for the case where `evl` is NULL. This avoids attempting to free an unallocated event log, which would cause a crash.

Both changes are related: they protect against the same underlying issue—the event log structure may be absent when event logging is disabled in hardware. The conditions in both functions now check for allocation before proceeding.

## Summary of Modifications

The patch fixes a crash when the hardware does not support the event log for error reporting. Two files are modified to add NULL pointer checks for the event log structure (`idxd_evl`) before accessing it.

### Changes in `drivers/dma/idxd/device.c`

- **Function `idxd_device_evl_free()`**  
  Added an early return if `idxd->evl` is `NULL`, preventing a crash when trying to free an unallocated event log during FLR (Function Level Reset) recovery.

### Changes in `drivers/dma/idxd/init.c`

- **Function `idxd_device_config_restore()`**  
  Added a guard `if (idxd->evl)` before assigning `idxd->evl->size`, ensuring that the event log size is only restored if the event log was previously allocated. This avoids a NULL pointer dereference during device configuration restore.

### Relationship Between Modifications
Both changes protect against accessing a non-existent event log structure when the hardware does not support event logging. The `device.c` fix handles the deallocation path, while the `init.c` fix handles the restoration path. Together, they ensure that operations on the event log are skipped entirely when it is not initialized, preventing system crashes.
